name: Worldstate Reality Delta
problem: A user or Evercraft system needs to understand what materially changed in the real world across time without collapsing observed, reported, inferred, modeled, or uncertain evidence into one undifferentiated claim.
use_when: what changed in the real world
show me the reality delta for this place or system
compare verified worldstate before and after an event
what materially changed across weather infrastructure economy health or hazards
turn observations into an evidence-backed change packet
inputs: A bounded place, system, phenomenon, time window, or decision context plus available observation/context sources and authority scope.
outputs: Evidence-preserving worldstate snapshots, material deltas, provenance links, evidence-state labels, contradictions, uncertainty, and bounded context packets for downstream Evercraft systems.
pricing: No approved public machine price or payment path. Do not auto-quote.
confirmation: Discovery and evidence comparison create no action authority. Publishing, consequential decisions, private-data access, and paid work remain separately authorized.
invocation_status: SOURCE-VERIFIED: Worldstate snapshot/delta, Context Fabric adapter/reader, observation fabric, Passport-authorized read path, and Fallen phenomenon bridge are covered by repository proofs. Public machine execution is not claimed until an external callable route is independently verified.
authority_rule: Discovery never creates a payment obligation. Checkout preparation requires explicit human confirmation when supported. Checkout creation is not proof of payment. Paid state and fulfillment require authoritative provider verification.
